coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

requirement: Preserve vertical motion after direction release. When a directional input is released while the character is airborne, the system shall preserve the ongoing vertical motion of the jump or fall.
coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

requirement: Identify the current level. While an attempt is open, the system shall display the number of the level being attempted.

coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

coverage_boundary: Uses shared stored data; UI/service behavior remains

coverage_boundary: Uses shared stored data; UI/service behavior remains

coverage_boundary: Direct storage or integrity rule

coverage_boundary: Uses shared stored data; UI/service behavior remains

coverage_boundary: Uses shared stored data; UI/service behavior remains

coverage_boundary: Direct storage or integrity rule

requirement: Offer completion actions. When completion is confirmed saved, the system shall display Replay, Back to Game Room, and Next Level when another level exists.
coverage_boundary: Uses shared stored data; UI/service behavior remains

requirement: Identify sequence completion. When completion of the final included level is confirmed saved, the system shall display a sequence-completion result containing Replay and Back to Game Room as its available next actions.
coverage_boundary: Uses shared stored data; UI/service behavior remains

requirement: Explain an unconfirmed completion save. When successful completion saving cannot be confirmed, the system shall display the retained completion result with a message stating that saving has not been confirmed.

coverage_boundary: Uses shared stored data; UI/service behavior remains

coverage_boundary: Direct storage or integrity rule

requirement: Replay a completed level. When Replay is selected from a confirmed-saved result, the system shall start a new attempt of that completed level.
coverage_boundary: Uses shared stored data; UI/service behavior remains

requirement: Continue to the next level. When Next Level is selected from a confirmed-saved result, the system shall start a new attempt of the next sequential level.
coverage_boundary: Uses shared stored data; UI/service behavior remains

requirement: End an attempt after a fall or hazard. When the character falls below the level's playable area or touches a hazard during running gameplay, the system shall end the attempt unsuccessfully.
coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

requirement: Explain the failure cause. When an attempt ends unsuccessfully, the system shall identify whether a fall or hazard contact caused the failure.
coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

requirement: Retry the current level. When Retry is selected after an unsuccessful attempt, the system shall start the same level from its initial state.
coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

requirement: Allow unlimited retries. When an attempt ends unsuccessfully, the system shall offer Retry regardless of the number of previous attempts.
coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

requirement: Pause on request. When Pause is selected during running gameplay, the system shall place the current attempt in the paused state.
coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

coverage_boundary: UI, transient state, or service-only; no new storage

coverage_boundary: Conditional feature; Direct storage or integrity rule

coverage_boundary: Conditional feature; Direct storage or integrity rule

requirement: Explain a daily transition. When the daily boundary replaces an unfinished puzzle, the system shall display a message explaining that the previous puzzle day ended.
